'''Lami''' was a [[Nomai]] who grew up on [[Brittle Hollow]] and [[Ember Twin]]. Their sibling was [[Laevi]] and their aunt was [[Pye]].<ref>LAMI: I’m still small enough! LAEVI: You won’t be for long. Mom and Dad are tall, so you and I will be tall, too.</ref><ref name=":0">LAMI: Why are we changing it? It’s too hard if you can’t see anything! LAEVI: Aunt Pye says real anglerfish are blind, so you have to wear a blindfold! The rule stands!</ref>

==Early life==
Lami played the [[Anglerfish]] game in the [[Sunless City]] with Laevi, [[Taget]], [[Ilex]], and [[Solanum]]. Lami was still small enough to climb through the hole at the Anglerfish Overlook to give the fossil a new lantern.<ref>TAGET: Are we playing the fossil fish game tonight? SOLANUM: I fed the fossil fish a new lantern. If you go to the Stepping Stone Cave, the entrance to the Fossil Fish Cave is easy to see now. LAEVI: Gratitude, Solanum! It’s good you’re small enough to climb in through the hole at the Anglerfish Overlook. LAMI: I’m still small enough!</ref> When Laevi wanted to add a rule that the child who played the anglerfish had to wear a blindfold, Lami thought the game was too hard if they could not see anything.<ref name=":0" /> Ilex eventually updated this rule so that the younger children did not have to wear a blindfold.<ref>ILEX: Rule update: It’s okay if younger kids don’t wear the blindfold when they’re it. (The rest of us will still wear it for scientific accuracy and to make the game more even.)</ref>

Lami went to school in the [[Hanging City]], where they wrote an explanation of the Nomai's festivals.<ref>LAMI: Explanation of Festivals LAMI: All the Nomai clans from all over the universe meet in one place to share what they’ve learned in science and art. It’s called the festival!</ref> 

==Statue Workshop==
When the [[Ash Twin Project]] began, Lami, Laevi, and Taget moved to the [[Statue Workshop]] on [[Giant's Deep]], where [[Phlox]] was creating the [[Nomai Statue|memory statues]]. Phlox told them not to come inside during a test of the statues, but Lami wanted to sneak in through the other entrance.<ref>LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come. LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to?</ref> However, Taget and Laevi told Lami that they should not do this as the risk is too high.<ref>TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that. LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.</ref>

When the [[Ghost Matter]] from the [[Interloper]] instantly flooded the [[solar system]], Lami passed away along with all other Nomai.

== Trivia ==

* ''[[Wikipedia:Lamium|Lamium]]'' (otherwise known as dead-nettles) are a genus of flowering plants native to Asia, Europe and parts of Africa.
